<function name="SetAllowLua" parent="DHTML" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Determines whether the loaded page can run Lua code or not. See <page>DHTML</page> for how to run Lua from a DHTML window.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="allow" type="boolean" default="false">Whether or not to allow Lua.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
